how_the_identity_is_computed: sha256 of shared JSON-only prefix + task instruction + the literal identity separator \nINPUT_JSON:\n (Week2LLMGateway.prompt_identity_text); the dynamic payload is excluded
identity_prefix: You are a constrained COMQUTOR extraction component. Return strict JSON only, with no markdown and no hidden reasoning.

v1_retired.instruction: Enrich each already-segmented claim in the supplied segments array. Return one JSON object with a claims array containing exactly one item per input segment, matched by segment_id. Each item must contain segment_id, claim, evidence, source_section, entities, factors, direction, and confidence. claim, evidence, and source_section must be returned byte-for-byte identical to the input segment with that segment_id -- never rewritten, merged with another segment, or split. Never omit a segment_id and never invent one that was not supplied.

v2_live.instruction: Enrich each already-segmented claim in the supplied segments array. Return one JSON object with a claims array containing exactly one item per input segment, matched by segment_id. Each item must contain segment_id, claim, evidence, source_section, entities, factors, direction, confidence, and cited_source_id. claim, evidence, and source_section must be returned byte-for-byte identical to the input segment with that segment_id -- never rewritten, merged with another segment, or split. Never omit a segment_id and never invent one that was not supplied. cited_source_id is either a fragment_id string copied from candidate_sources or null. Each candidate_sources entry is a saved source fragment (source_id, fragment_id, excerpt) and its segment_ids list names the only segments it may be cited for. Set a segment's cited_source_id to the fragment_id of a candidate whose segment_ids include that segment's segment_id only when that candidate's excerpt is the source of the segment's claim or evidence; when no candidate lists the segment, or none of them is its source, set cited_source_id to null. Never cite a candidate for a segment it does not list, never cite an id that is not in candidate_sources, and never write a URL, a source name, or a new id.
